text: The author employs a third-person omniscient point of view, observing the detective’s narration from an external perspective rather than inhabiting the detective’s mind directly. This narrative distance allows the author to comment on the detective’s style with a sense of critical appreciation. The tone of the passage is analytical and admiring, characterized by a formal and objective voice. The author uses precise, unembellished language to mirror the "clinical detachment" they attribute to the detective, creating a tone that is respectful of the subject’s professionalism while maintaining a clear, intellectual distance.
